MACT, Bailhongal.

sentences.text: 2. Respondent No.2 who has sustained injury in a road traffic accident has made a claim petition.

The Tribunal after recording evidence and appreciating the evidence on record has awarded compensation as under:
Sl.No. Heads Amount 1. Pain and suffering Rs.40,000/-
2. Loss of amenities and future Rs.20,000/-
 unhappiness 3.

Medical expenses incurred Rs.1,05,000/-
4. Incidental expenses Rs.10,000/-
5. Loss of income during laid up and rest Rs.18,000/-
period 6.

Loss of future income Rs.1,96,000/-
7.

Future medical expenses -- Total Rs.3,89,000/-
3.
The insurance company has challenged the said judgment on the ground that the compensation awarded is on higher side and also the interest awarded at 9% p.a. is also higher side.
Heard learned counsel for the appellant/insurance company and learned counsel for respondent No.1.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the appellant would contend that he is now not challenging the quantum of compensation but interest at 9% p.a is higher side.
6. Learned counsel for respondent No.1 submits that the interest awarded at 9% is proper and correct.
7. As the learned counsel for appellant did not argue on quantum of compensation, this Court is not going to consider the appeal with regard to quantum of compensation as awarded by the Tribunal.
The Tribunal has awarded interest at the rate of 9% p.a from the date of petition till realization.

Considering the decision of Hon'ble Apex Court, interest at 9% p.a. is on higher side and the Tribunal ought to have awarded interest at 6% p.a.
8.

In view of the above, the following:
NC: 2024:KHC-D:13092 ORDER i.
The appeal is allowed-in-part.
ii. The compensation awarded by the Tribunal in MVC No.2888/2012 dated 23.07.2014 is remained altered.
The interest awarded at the rate of 9% p.a is reduced to 6% p.a.
Other aspects in the award are remained unaltered.
iii. Amount in deposit is ordered to be transmitted to the Tribunal.
iv. Registry is directed to return TCR with copy of this judgment.

Sd/-
(SHIVASHANKAR AMARANNAVAR) JUDGE RKM CT:ANB The Divisional Manager vs Ashok Basappa Yargatti on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/81297127/
